ruleText: Ordinary hold, city, Imperial and Stormcloak guards scale 1:1 with the player, minimum level 5, no +20 offset. The winning record's own level cap (50) is kept. Named guards, captains, commanders, quest actors and mod-added guard equivalents are audited separately and are not touched (user rule, #51, 2026-08-29; audit records/guard-scaling-audit-2026-09-02.md).

targets.role: stats template for every Imperial-held hold and city guard (Whiterun, Solitude, Markarth, Falkreath, Morthal, Dragon Bridge, Kolskeggr, Karthwasten and the CW-flipped variants); vanilla PCx1.0 min 20 max 50, USSEP forwards the same values
stats template for every Stormcloak-held hold and city guard (Windhelm, Riften, Dawnstar, Winterhold and the CW-flipped variants); vanilla PCx1.0 min 20 max 50, USSEP forwards the same values
stats template for the Raven Rock Redoran city guards (17 placed guard records); vanilla PCx1.0 min 20 max 50, no override in the profile
